stories.headline: Seven swimming golds for Zhang Zhanshuo at the Asian Games
stories.summary: China's Zhang Zhanshuo won the men's 400 metre freestyle on the final day of swimming at the 2026 Asian Games, in a time of 3:41.28. It was his seventh gold of the Games, and no athlete had won seven at a single Asian Games before. The swim also passed the Games record of 3:41.53 that Park Tae-hwan set in 2010.

stories.headline: Two more countries sign up to the Artemis Accords
stories.summary: Croatia has become the 74th country to sign the U.S.-led Artemis Accords, and the accession of Ivory Coast has taken the total to 75. The Accords set out a framework for cooperation in the civil exploration and peaceful use of the Moon, Mars and other astronomical objects. They were drafted by NASA and the US Department of State.

stories.headline: CERN starts changing the magnets inside the Large Hadron Collider
stories.summary: CERN has begun dismantling sections of the Large Hadron Collider so that the magnets which focus its particle beams can be replaced. The new ones use niobium-tin superconducting coils and reach 11.3 tesla, about 40% stronger than the fields the current magnets produce. The collider stretches 27 km around.
